# ADR-0002: Use spraakbanken/python-uv-ci-conf for CI

> **Status:** accepted | **Date:** 2026-01-23

## Context

Stable and extensive CI is valueable for automatic releases
and PR revision.

## Decision

Use the CI setup in spraakbanken/python-uv-ci-conf.

## Consequences

Positive: Easy setup and updates.
Negative: All the history from python-uv-ci-conf repo is included.
